# The existing common-Faith scholar route remains separate from detached HoR.

                this = var:lyd_i3b_required_native_hor
                var:lyd_i3b_main.head_of_rite = var:lyd_i3b_required_native_hor
            }
            trigger_else = { always = no }
        }
    }
}
